pairs: Post Abimelech surrexit dux in Israël Thola filius Phua patrui Abimelech, vir de Issachar, qui habitavit in Samir montis Ephraim:
After Abimelech, a leader rose up in Israel, Tola, the son of Puah, the paternal uncle of Abimelech, a man of Issachar, who lived in Shamir on mount Ephraim.
et judicavit Israëlem viginti et tribus annis,
And he judged Israel for twenty-three years,
who judged Israel for twenty-two years,
habens triginta filios sedentes super triginta pullos asinarum,
having thirty sons sitting upon thirty young donkeys,
and who were leaders of thirty cities,
quæ ex nomine ejus sunt appellatæ Havoth Jair,
which from his name were called Havvoth Jair,
ac sepultus in loco cui est vocabulum Camon.
and he was buried in the place which is called Kamon.
Filii autem Israël peccatis veteribus jungentes nova,
But the sons of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord,
et diis Syriæ ac Sidonis et Moab et filiorum Ammon et Philisthiim:
and the gods of Syria and Sidon, and of Moab and the sons of Ammon, and the Philistines.
and they did not worship him.
delivered them into the hands of the Philistines and the sons of Ammon.
et vehementer oppressi per annos decem et octo,
and vehemently oppressed for eighteen years,
omnes qui habitabant trans Jordanem in terra Amorrhæi,
all who were living beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorite,
to such a great extent that the sons of Ammon,
vastarent Judam et Benjamin et Ephraim:
laid waste to Judah and Benjamin and Ephraim.
And crying out to the Lord,
For we have forsaken the Lord our God,
and we have served the Baals.”
And the Lord said to them:
Sidonii quoque et Amalec et Chanaan oppresserunt vos,
and also the Sidonians, and Amalek, and Canaan,
oppress you, and so you cried out to me,
et erui vos de manu eorum?
and I rescued you from their hand?
And yet you have forsaken me,
and you have worshipped foreign gods.
idcirco non addam ut ultra vos liberem:
For this reason, I will not continue to free you any more.
and call upon the gods whom you have chosen.
ipsi vos liberent in tempore angustiæ.
Let them free you in the time of anguish.”
And the sons of Israel said to the Lord:
redde tu nobis quidquid tibi placet:
You may repay us in whatever way pleases you.
omnia de finibus suis alienorum deorum idola projecerunt,
they cast out all the idols of the foreign gods from their regions,
and they served the Lord God.
And he was touched by their miseries.
Itaque filii Ammon conclamantes in Galaad fixere tentoria,
And then the sons of Ammon, shouting out together, pitched their tents in Gilead.
contra quos congregati filii Israël in Maspha castrametati sunt.
And the sons of Israel gathered together against them, and they made camp at Mizpah.
Dixeruntque principes Galaad singuli ad proximos suos:
And the leaders of Gilead said to one another,
Qui primus ex nobis contra filios Ammon cœperit dimicare,
“Whoever among us will be the first to begin to contend against the sons of Ammon,
he shall be the leader of the people of Gilead.”
